That block is the September reporting month: its predecessor, 8/3/2026 to 8/28/2026, is August. p_ams_chicken_pdf now takes the month holding most of the block's days and the retained capture was re-parsed, so the same readings are present under 2026-09 with period_start and period_end recorded.
